description: CGS Seismic Hazards Program: Landslide Zones is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Conservation. This is a digital Seismic Hazard Zone Map presenting areas where liquefaction and landslides may occur during a strong earthquake. Three types of geological hazards, referred to as seismic hazard zones, may be featured on the map: 1) liquefaction, 2) earthquake-induced landslides, and 3) overlapping liquefaction and earthquake-induced landslides. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Conservation. Its tags are CAOpenData, CGS, California, California Department of Conservation, California Geological Survey. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
